HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

4. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   C. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Myself has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
